description: Read one Figma frame and transactionally write frame.png, node.json, and a normalized imageRef-to-URL fills.json map under the output directory. Returns upstream request proof plus local size, SHA-256, PNG structure/dimensions, and JSON read-back proof. Existing unrelated files are preserved.

file_key.description: File key parsed from the Figma URL.

node_id.description: Exact frame node ID, normally colon-form such as 2968:811.

out_dir.description: Output directory for this frame. Relative paths resolve below the output root (default ./figma-output), which is created on first use; absolute paths must stay below it.

name: fetch_frame
